mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate from the prior month predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as lower short-term interest rates reduce equity discount rates and boost valuation multiples.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS decline months produce positive 20-day returns in less than 45% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5%, it signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.5% months produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) from the prior month signal robust consumer demand that drives corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint HOUST/RSAFS increase months produce positive 60-day returns in less than 45% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in industrial production growth (year-over-year) below 0.5% signals supply constraints that increase inflation and reduce corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth < 0.5% months produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL yoy > 3.5% months produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth above 10-year average quarters produce positive 20-day returns in less than 45% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in employment (PAYEMS) and declines in unemployment (UNRATE) from the prior month signal a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint PAYEMS increase/UNRATE decline months produce positive 60-day returns in less than 45% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1,050,000 units, it signals a housing market boom that supports consumer confidence and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1050 months produce negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
